request.deadline: Three-month liquidity deployment after enactment with monthly reporting; other final delivery deadline not stated in document
deliverables: Shared BTC reserve architecture with transparent safety mechanisms and reserve-ratio rules
Composable Cardano-native FIRE and ICE assets
Open-source SDKs and adapters for wallets, DEXs, and DeFi protocols
Always-on public dashboards for reserve ratio, asset supply, liquidity health, fee flows, and deployment status
Monthly governance reports and BTCfi reporting standards
Independent security review, audit, and economic modeling
Legal, compliance, disclosures, treasury reporting, risk documentation, and launch-readiness review
Ecosystem education, DRep communications, partner activation, and launch coordination
request.recipient: Sundial Protocol and Charms, with Intersect proposed as interim fund administrator subject to confirmation and final agreement.
request.what: Build and launch Alchemy, a Cardano-native Bitcoin treasury protocol and BTCfi infrastructure layer with reserve architecture, FIRE and ICE assets, dashboards, adapters, reporting, audits, administration, legal/compliance work, and staged launch liquidity.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 10,000,000 ada, using an approximate USD 0.20 per ada reference rate for an approximate USD 2.0 million planning budget.

The requested budget is split into two separated pools of approximately USD 1.0 million each, one for protocol infrastructure and staged launch liquidity and one for delivery, audit, integrations, dashboards, governance reporting, legal/compliance work, and go-to-market execution.
Launch liquidity will be treasury-supported and treasury-owned, and profits, yield, and returns generated by the launch liquidity position will be returned to the Cardano Treasury quarterly.

The principal can be returned to the Treasury after Alchemy reaches a 30-day time-weighted average TVL of at least USD 60 million, subject to a formal governance proposal for DRep and Constitutional Committee review.
Alchemy plans FIRE and ICE to share a BTC reserve with a target initial reserve ratio of 5.0x and safety zones that constrain minting and redemption below specified reserve-ratio thresholds.
FIRE is described as the volatility-absorbing residual BTC claim, while ICE is described as lower-volatility USD-denominated BTC-backed exposure with growth potential.

The proposal acknowledges BTC volatility, oracle, bridge, and Charms protocol-layer risks and says mitigation includes independent security review, economic modeling, staged launch, dashboards, and pause rules.
Cardano currently lacks a production BTCfi infrastructure layer and risks Bitcoin-backed structured exposure consolidating on other chains and off-chain markets.
The document cites Strategy, Strive, Apyx, Saturn, and Pendle as evidence that demand for Bitcoin-backed structured exposure is real and growing.
Intersect is proposed as interim fund administrator, and administrator-held ada would be kept in auditable accounts and delegated to auto-abstain rather than to a Stake Pool Operator.

summary: The document describes a 10,000,000 ada treasury withdrawal for a Cardano BTCfi infrastructure protocol with separated delivery and liquidity pools, staged deployment, public reporting, audits, and treasury-return mechanisms, but many execution, adoption, administrator, and risk-control claims remain proposer assertions or externally checkable rather than demonstrated in the anchor text.
